description.html: The Sheet Pan was created in partnership with Chef Matt Horn, the award-winning pitmaster behind Oakland’s Horn Barbecue. It’s specifically designed to withstand the rigor and heat of professional kitchens, making it durable enough for years of daily sheet pan dinners and spur of the moment baking. Each one is manufactured in the USA from imported commercial grade 3004 Aluminum to minimize weight and optimize heat conduction. This means cookies, biscuits, and more stop baking as soon as they emerge golden brown from the oven—your best protection against scorched and blackened bottoms. Unlike other cheaply made Sheet Pans, ours features a fully enclosed and rolled rim to act as a levee against juices escaping, prevent warping, and make cleanup easier.

Designed with and for Chef Nancy Silverton, the Baking Slab is the first of its kind. It begins with a 202-year-old Porcelain recipe held secret by skilled artisans in the Loire Valley. The finest and most precious of all bakeware materials, it is also the most demanding to produce. Kaolins, clays, quartz, and feldspars are mixed, shaped, enameled, and baked three times for over 50 hours at temperatures exceeding 2500F. Porcelain provides even heating, ensuring crisp corners and gooey middles without over or underbaked spots. Ours is microwave- and oven-safe up to 650F and thermal shock resistant, meaning it can go from freezer to oven to table with ease. Perfect for slab pies, focaccia, sheet cakes, and more, discover how this unique Bakeware can make your most cherished recipes even better.

Our Wood Fiber boards are made from Richlite, a paper-based composite pressed from layers of FSC-certified or 100% recycled paper, saturated with phenolic resin, then baked into dense, solid sheets. The surface is non-porous, so it resists the bacteria, odors, and moisture that wear down traditional wood, and it's hard enough to shrug off the cracking, splitting, and warping that ages a board fast. The same composite holds up in professional kitchens, and it's dishwasher safe with no oiling, conditioning, or drying. We built it as a three-piece set because one board never fits every task. The Large and Medium boards carry a juice groove around the perimeter to catch drips from a roast or a ripe tomato, while the slim Prep board handles quick work like fruit and garnish. Every board is dual-sided, giving you two clean surfaces to move between raw and ready. All three are light enough to pull out, store, and hand off across the kitchen with one hand. Wash, dry upright, and go.

Our Stainless Gratin Dish is made from high-grade stainless steel for a modern take on the classic French bakeware style. Even heat distribution and a durable, scratch- and rust-resistant construction guarantee perfect results, whether you’re making old-school potatoes au gratin or heating up leftovers for a quick meal. With curved walls and an oval shape, the Gratin Dish is perfect for baking or warming up small dishes (like a two-person-sized serving of crispy-lidded mac & cheese). Ample surface area, plus a shallower profile than the typical casserole or baking dish, encourages quick, even heating and browning. The sleek, low-profile design also makes this the ideal oven-to-table serving piece, blending seamlessly with your holiday (or year-round) tablescape.
